description: E-C non-ideality ablation (Table VIII / F11): loss vs ideal continuous phase per geometry, large-N eta, binary m/d decomposition and mirror share
assumptions: lab state amplitudes ASSUMED (|sigma1| = 1; |sigma2| as per row)
Tang RIS1 alphabet: published 27 GHz table values (REPORTED) applied as an angle-independent alphabet at each geometry's carrier [ENG]
Abeywickrama: beta_min 0.2, alpha 1.6, phi 0, b = 2 [ENG choice of b]
failure rows on the lab |Gamma| = 1 alphabet; the optimizer knows the failed cells; 200 keyed maps per point (lab, synthetic), 10 per position (corridor, averaged over the RWP pdf)

lab geometry: V-LAB prior median Tx (2 m, -22.5 deg) and the 30-point polar grid; SIM geometry, no measured data read
